ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a double-reciprocal plot of one of the three types of reversible inhibition of enzymes. Please determine which type of inhibition this is. \begin{center} \includegraphics[scale=0.5]{q_00350_001.png} \end{center}
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a double-reciprocal plot of an enzyme-catalyzed reaction, that is, the vertical axis is 1/v, and the horizontal axis is 1/[S]. There are multiple straight lines, labeled “normal” and “[I] increased”. As the inhibitor concentration [I] increases, the slope of the straight lines becomes larger, and the vertical-axis intercept increases; when these straight lines are extrapolated to the left, they converge at the same negative horizontal-axis intercept, namely -1/Km. Then reason: In a Lineweaver-Burk plot, an unchanged horizontal-axis intercept -1/Km indicates that Km is unchanged; an increased vertical-axis intercept 1/Vmax indicates that Vmax decreases. Unchanged Km and decreased Vmax are characteristics of noncompetitive inhibition. Therefore, this inhibition type is noncompetitive inhibition.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it is a 1/v versus 1/[S] double-reciprocal plot with several straight lines labeled normal and increasing inhibitor concentration. The lines converge at the same negative x-intercept −1/Km, but higher inhibitor gives a steeper line and a larger y-intercept. From the question text, identify that the task is to choose among reversible enzyme inhibition types. Apply the Lineweaver–Burk diagnostic rule: unchanged Km with decreased Vmax corresponds to non-competitive inhibition. Therefore the inhibition type is non-competitive suppression/inhibition.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是酶促反应的双倒数作图，即纵轴为 1/v，横轴为 1/[S]。有多条直线，标有“正常”和“[I]加大”。随着抑制剂浓度 [I] 增大，直线斜率变大，纵轴截距增大；这些直线向左外推时汇聚在同一个负横轴截距，即 -1/Km。再推理：在 Lineweaver-Burk 图中，横轴截距 -1/Km 不变表示 Km 不变；纵轴截距 1/Vmax 增大表示 Vmax 减小。Km 不变而 Vmax 降低是非竞争性抑制的特征。因此该抑制类型为非竞争性抑制。
method.model_answer: 非竞争性抑制（non-competitive inhibition / suppression）

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the graph as a double-reciprocal plot with vertical axis 1/v and horizontal axis 1/[S]. planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In Lineweaver–Burk plots, pure non-competitive inhibition leaves Km unchanged, so the x-intercept −1/Km is unchanged, but lowers Vmax, so 1/Vmax and the slope increase. Competitive inhibition would share the y-intercept, and uncompetitive inhibition would give parallel lines.
